# Widget { #anylumino.astryx.Widget }

```python
Widget(
    component_name='Stack',
    children=None,
    *,
    props=None,
    text='',
    label='',
    value=None,
    disabled=False,
    variant='',
    brand=None,
    color_mode='light',
    continuous_update=True,
    search=None,
    callbacks=None,
    action_callbacks=None,
    open=None,
    width=None,
    height=None,
    **kwargs,
)
```

Base anywidget for Astryx-backed components.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name              | Type                                                           | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | Default   |
|-------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| component_name    | str                                                            | Frontend Astryx component name registered in the anylumino bridge.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `'Stack'` |
| children          | ChildInput                                                     | Child widget, sequence of widgets, or mapping of slot names to widgets.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | `None`    |
| props             | Mapping\[str, Any\] \| None                                    | Additional JSON-safe props for the selected Astryx component. Use this for component options that are not modeled as widget traits. anylumino manages widget composition, value synchronization, callbacks, and brand/theme traits separately. Upstream React-only values such as functions, refs, and React nodes are not serializable from Python. See the Astryx docs for the selected component page, for example <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Blockquote>. | `None`    |
| text              | str                                                            | Text content synchronized to the frontend.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | `''`      |
| label             | str                                                            | Visible or accessible component label.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `''`      |
| value             | Any                                                            | Synchronized component value.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | `None`    |
| disabled          | bool                                                           | Whether the component is disabled.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `False`   |
| variant           | str                                                            | Astryx visual variant.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `''`      |
| brand             | Mapping\[str, Any\] \| None                                    | Runtime or built Astryx theme descriptor.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | `None`    |
| color_mode        | str                                                            | Astryx ``Theme`` mode. Use ``"light"``, ``"dark"``, ``"system"`` to follow the OS ``prefers-color-scheme``, or ``"jupyterlab"`` to follow the JupyterLab theme.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | `'light'` |
| continuous_update | bool                                                           | Whether Python receives text input, number input, and slider values while the user edits. When ``False`` the value syncs on blur, on Enter, and at the end of a slider drag.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | `True`    |
| search            | Callable\[\[str\], Iterable\[Any\]\] \| None                   | Optional Python-backed search callback for ``Typeahead``, ``Tokenizer``, and ``CommandPalette``. It receives the typed query and returns the matching items, and is the only path by which the query reaches Python. Astryx debounces the call by its ``debounceMs`` prop, 150ms by default; pass ``debounceMs=0`` for a local source that needs no debouncing. Without a callback the component filters its own items in the browser and nothing is sent per keystroke. | `None`    |
| callbacks         | Iterable\[Callable\[\[ComponentWidget\], None\]\] \| None      | Python activation callbacks.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | `None`    |
| action_callbacks  | Iterable\[Callable\[\[ComponentWidget, Any\], None\]\] \| None | Python callbacks receiving named action values.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | `None`    |
| open              | bool \| None                                                   | Optional controlled open state.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | `None`    |
| width             | int \| float \| str \| None                                    | Component host width.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | `None`    |
| height            | int \| float \| str \| None                                    | Component host height.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `None`    |

### apply_brand { #anylumino.astryx.Widget.apply_brand }

```python
apply_brand(brand, *, color_mode=None)
```

Apply a reusable Astryx brand identity to this widget subtree.
